spec.name: Rules
spec.purpose: Business rules registry (R-xxx) with status, pages and where implemented.

spec.name: Page canvas

thumbnails are same-origin iframes at 1280 scaled to the card

spec.name: QA preview
spec.purpose: Any route side by side at 360 / 390 / 768 / 1280 / 1920 / 2560 / 3840 in same-origin iframes scaled to fit.

spec.name: Feedback inbox
spec.purpose: Annotations triage: every feedback row; set triage (fix / ask / later / wontfix), status and decision_ref before changing anything (P-08).
logic: writes by id through the provider

spec.name: Testing hub
spec.purpose: Start here: switch language, theme, dev mode and role; open every surface (prospect landing pages, OS demo live in a phone, studio, analytics, plan, proposal, website, docs, manual, dev tools) and see the build counts.
layout: prospects: landing pages per archetype + demo
logic: counts = routes / built / stubs / tables / rules / components from registries
prospect cards read live pages and the savings from the composed model

spec.name: No access
spec.purpose: Friendly page when the current role cannot open a route; offers the hub and the roles that can.
logic: reads ?from= and lists roles allowed on that route
